data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 厨房里的失败煎蛋
data.description: 【家中厨房·清晨】杏菜系着奶油色围裙尝试给自己做煎蛋，蛋黄不小心破开后她盯着锅沉默三秒；随后把“失败品”装进盘子，举向镜头宣布这叫半熟风味。
data.action: 厨房里煎蛋破黄沉默三秒，把失败品装盘宣布为半熟风味
data.lighting: fresh morning light over the stove
data.mood: 把失败料理也吃成自信名场面
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami stares silently at the broken yolk in her breakfast pan, cream apron tied over a yellow long-sleeved top and blue trousers. After the brief pause, she slides the egg onto a plate and lifts it toward the viewer with renewed confidence. The vertical medium view includes stove and counter behind. Fresh morning light illuminates the egg's glossy surface and apron, with pan-handle shadows and pale reflected brightness on her face.
